Subject: Numbers Ready? Submission Heads-up & Call Prep

Team — quick heads-up for Q2 submission this week. Deadline for final commit is Friday 4/14 at 5pm PT. Please do the following before our scheduled prep call on Friday at 10:00am PT:

- Update HubSpot ACME opportunity with final ARR and expected close date (link below).
- Set stage to "Commit" only if legal/finance milestones are complete. If still in contracting, set stage to "Commit - Contingent" and add short note.
- Attach the completed submission sheet (I’ve attached the working workbook).

Agenda for Friday 10:00am PT (15–20 minutes):
1) Rollup: accounts moved to Commit since last check (2–3 mins)
2) Focused triage: ACME (Karthik) and Orion (Marissa) — blockers and ask (8–10 mins)
3) Final actions and owners for submission (3–5 mins)

Please flag any deals you think should be escalated earlier. I’ve attached a snapshot for ACME and the current submission workbook.

Attachments: 2028_Q2_submission_sheet.xlsx, acme_commit_snapshot.pdf
Links: https://hubspot.example/record/ACME-42, https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/forecast_q2

—Jonas

> Thanks Jonas — I’ll update ACME and attach the signed NDA from yesterday (placeholder attached). Quick ask: for ACME, they confirmed PO issuance next week but legal says billing start is contingent on SOC2 evidence by 4/20. I recommend we keep ACME as "Commit - Contingent" until SOC2 is confirmed, but include full ARR in the submission workbook and annotate contingencies.

Agree with Marissa — one more nuance: the customer's expected close date moved from 4/30 to 5/14 during procurement. If we show the earlier close in our submission, revenue may be pulled forward incorrectly. Suggest we: (a) include the original committed ARR in the workbook, (b) set expected close date to 2028-05-14, and (c) add a comment in the submission sheet and HubSpot noting the SOC2 dependency.

Also, quick question for Jonas: are we treating "Commit - Contingent" as full-commit for quota math this week or excluding from commit? We’ve had mixed signals from CRO on this in previous cycles.

—Karthik
